g.text: Ours: what Orchestra owns and runs
Interface: where work crosses, and my outbox

g.title: Someone asks me for a simple task — crosses: slack/jira in
Collect the requirements (me, in the conversation)
Research the problem, find stakeholders and related projects — crosses: read: jira, docs, slack, code
Author the ticket with requirements and completion criteria
Approve the ticket (me) — crosses: jira write (via outbox)
Implement on a branch
Run tests, internal AI review; sent back or passed. Internal rework loop: a quarter go back for another implementation pass.
Run tests, internal AI review; sent back or passed. Internal rework loop: a quarter go back for another implementation pass.
Approve the PR description; push and open the PR — crosses: github push + open PR
Company PR checks

Fix check failures — crosses: read: check logs; github push
Company AI review
Company AI review
Address the AI review's comments — crosses: read: PR comments; github push
Post for review in our and owning teams' channels (me approves) — crosses: slack write (via outbox)
Ping reviewers about a waiting PR, about once a day. Auto after the template earned autonomy; until then each ping is an outbox item. — crosses: slack write
Pings fade from reviewers' minds
Human review. Mean first response 16 working hours at one recent ping per waiting PR; slower with none.
Human review. Mean first response 16 working hours at one recent ping per waiting PR; slower with none.
Address reviewers' comments; draft replies — crosses: read: review threads
Approve replies; push; re-request review — crosses: github push + replies (via outbox)
